companyFieldUpdates.name: New Leaf Energy
companyFieldUpdates.description: New Leaf Energy, Inc. is a U.S. solar and energy-storage development platform formed in 2022 through the carve-out of Borrego's development business. It originates and advances commercial, community and utility-scale projects through siting, interconnection, permitting, offtake and construction-ready handoff. ECP completed its acquisition on July 27, 2022 and continues to list New Leaf as current; its exact current stake, fund and holding vehicle are not publicly disclosed. Walsin Lihwa's controlling block was sold in the 2022 transaction, and Walsin America separately sold back its entire 88,729-share block to New Leaf, leaving Walsin with no current interest. Borrego's retained EPC/O&M/Anza businesses and individual project companies or portfolios remain outside the canonical platform. ECP reports a pipeline of approximately 15 GW of solar and 7 GW of storage, with about 1 GW of photovoltaic projects and 450 MWh of battery projects sold. No later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.
